votre_roue_astrologique_constitue_le_poi: Your astrological wheel serves as the starting point for your Signature analysis. The following pages will connect the planets, signs, houses, angles, and aspects to reveal the major dynamics that shape your personality, talents, and evolution.
l_anneau_exterieur_presente_les_douze_si: The outer ring displays the twelve zodiac signs. Each sign describes a particular way of expressing energy. When a planet is in a sign, it adopts its qualities, needs, reflexes, and manner of acting.
les_maisons_divisent_la_roue_en_douze_se: The houses divide the wheel into twelve sectors. They represent the major areas of your existence: identity, resources, communication, home, creativity, work, relationships, transformation, aspirations, and vocation.
les_planetes_symbolisent_les_differentes: The planets symbolize the different functions of your personality. Their sign shows how they express themselves, while their house indicates in which area of your life their influence manifests.
les_lignes_tracees_au_centre_relient_les: The lines drawn in the center connect the planets to each other. They represent the astrological aspects. Some facilitate a natural expression of your energies, while others reveal tensions, contrasts, or challenges that foster evolution.
l_ascendant_indique_votre_maniere_d_abor: The Ascendant indicates your approach to the world. The Descendant describes your relationship with others. The Midheaven concerns your vocation and social direction. The Imum Coeli represents your roots and inner security.
aucun_element_ne_doit_etre_interprete_is: No element should be interpreted in isolation. The richness of your chart comes from the combination of planets, signs, houses, angles, and aspects. It is their dialogue that reveals your personal astrological signature.
les_pages_suivantes_approfondiront_progr: The following pages will progressively delve into each of these elements to illuminate your personality, emotional world, way of loving, natural strengths, challenges, and potential for evolution.
cette_page_constitue_votre_guide_de_refe: This page serves as your reference guide to understand the interpretation logic of your Signature report.
